patch_description:
Replace the unstructured Gaussian sample with a reproducible multi-start optimization for the actual scale-invariant squared distance ratio.  The solver keeps every candidate centered and normalized, then uses a continuation of smooth minimum/maximum squared-distance objectives.  The smooth minimum repels the current closest pairs while the smooth maximum contracts the current farthest pairs.  Several fixed-seed starts are evaluated and the candidate with the best exact (non-smoothed) minimum-squared-distance divided by maximum-squared-distance is returned.

This directly targets the evaluator's metric while avoiding any dependency beyond NumPy.  The returned array is always finite and has shape `(14, 3)`.
